subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and meet Yae Miko

120420101.text: Someone's not in the best of moods... Let me guess, you're all tangled up in another situation and need me to unravel it for you?

120420102.text: I hope you realize how lucky you are. If it was anyone else, I don't think I'd have the patience to keep greeting them with a smile after the first few times.

120420104.text: That was a figure of speech, do you understand? Nitpicking my turns of phrase, the sheer audacity.

120420106.text: Oh, yeah, yeah! Something really big's happened! It's Ei, she... she...

120420107.text: You tell Yae Miko about everything that has happened...

120420108.text: Oh, okay, I see. So Ei's decided to palm Inazuma off onto the humans, while she goes off on her own to fight a fierce battle that doesn't even have an end date...

120420109.text: Impossibly stubborn, jumps straight to the most extreme course of action imaginable, presumes her sheer will can see her through, despite a near-impossible goal that requires nothing short of the very peak of her abilities... Yes, that sounds like Ei, alright.

120420110.text: You know as well as I do that she's always been like this. Why start fretting about it now?

120420113.text: Rushed into it without thinking... Hehe, well put. Ah, she acts like such a child sometimes.

120420114.text: So, you seem to be under the impression that I am able to offer some sort of help? Who gave you that idea?

120420115.text: Is she playing dumb? She's doing this on purpose for sure!

120420116.text: Aha, you're learning, little one. But really, the truth of the matter is that I don't know much more about Raiden Makoto's realm of consciousness than you do.

120420117.text: All I know is that it's the foundation of the Sacred Sakura, and from what I have heard it's a little different from Ei's "Plane of Euthymia."

120420118.text: Because Raiden Makoto is no longer alive?

120420119.text: Not just because of that. The nature of the space itself is different in some way... But I can only speculate. You're the ones who have actually been there, so you tell me — what was it like?

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the entrance to the secret realm

120420303.text: You have returned... But how were you able to get back in? And... how come you have not changed at all in all these years...

120420305.text: This is a duel to remember.

120420306.text: It is as if we have returned to the moment when the laws of eternity were first established. Your will today is as strong as it was back then.

120420307.text: Over countless battles, not once have you lost, and never have you shown the slightest hesitation.

120420308.text: Had I made all enemies of eternity stand against you, you still would not have wavered.

120420309.text: For your firm commitment to enforcing the rules, you have my admiration, too.

120420310.text: You bring honor to the title of "Guardian of Eternity."

120420311.text: Now these two return once more to this space. An inevitability of fate, perhaps.

120420312.text: Then let this be our final duel, the conclusion to that which began 500 years ago.

120420313.text: Final duel? So you're finally willing to...

120420315.text: Are you going to put an end to all this?

120420316.text: I'm going to be the start of something new.

120420201.text: Now then, I always have my ways. It's just a question of how crafty I need to be...

120420202.text: To the outsider, the realm of consciousness is a very abstract concept. Luckily, I'm Ei's familiar, so I can sense her rough whereabouts.

120420203.text: In other words, even though I can't pinpoint the exact spatial location of this realm, I can still send you to where Ei is.

120420204.text: So it's abstract, but has a location, but you don't know where it is, but you can still send us there... what?

120420205.text: Yes, no need to try and understand it. Let me put this simply: Right now, she is surrounded by chaos.

120420206.text: Everything is turbulent and disordered... If you try to force your way in, you could be swept away by a giant wave that sets you down in an unknown corner of space-time.

120420207.text: This is precisely why when entering the Plane of Euthymia, it's much safer if you place your consciousness in a physical object first.

120420208.text: What? Alright, well Paimon's staying here, then. You two can go in!

120420211.text: Suit yourself. Worst-case scenario, all we stand to lose is Ei, so what's the big deal?

120420212.text: You... Ugh! Paimon's had it up to here with both of you! Fine, Paimon's coming too...

120420213.text: Oh? Well if you're quite sure, then of course. Now, I shall send you on your way.

120420217.text: Oh, nothing. It just seems extraordinarily chaotic, that's all. My suspicions have been confirmed.

120420218.text: By the way... Remember to focus constantly on your heartfelt wishes when you enter inside.

120420219.text: Only a strong enough will can prevent you from being swallowed by the giant waves of abstract space. Only if you are strong enough can I deliver you to the right destination.

120420221.text: Well then. The door is open. Hop on in.

120420222.text: I'll stay outside and provide what stability I can. I'll be ready to respond if anything happens.

120420223.text: #...I'm placing my god in your capable hands, {NICKNAME}.

120420224.text: For my sake, and for Inazuma's, please... bring her back.

120420225.text: Miko, you'd better know what you're doing...

120420227.text: That's enough chatter. Get to work!

subQuests.subQuestName: Force your way into the realm

120420501.text: After leaving the realm of consciousness and returning to the shrine, you relay everything to Yae Miko...

120420502.text: So the Ei of the present planted the Sacred Sakura in the realm of consciousness, and it took root in the Inazuma of the past...

120420503.text: No matter what you make of it, it's quite incredible.

120420504.text: All of this is thanks to Makoto's power. Her understanding of eternity is much more profound than mine.

120420505.text: Eternity is a concept intimately connected with time. When you begin to touch on eternity, the concept of time becomes murky.

120420506.text: I saw wonderful things inside that place.

120420507.text: Time was moving forward and backward at the same time.

120420508.text: A place where time is meaningless and cannot be understood with ordinary logic... So, that was the "turbulence" I was sensing.

120420509.text: Perhaps that is the reason why you were able to return precisely to this point in time without any problems.

120420510.text: And yet, that sense of disorderliness has now completely disappeared.

120420511.text: I don't fully understand yet. But my intuition tells me that the reason for everything... it's that seed.

120420512.text: Hmm, well I'm not convinced that it was Makoto's power alone...

120420513.text: I know what you mean. Perhaps a higher{RUBY#[S]Istaroth} power really was involved in all of this. But whatever the explanation, her solution is what saved us all.

120420514.text: Without the Sacred Sakura, Inazuma would likely have been completely swallowed up centuries ago by that disaster and the filth.

120420515.text: I know you've always perceived there was something special about the Sacred Sakura. But to me, it has always been there.

120420516.text: You've tried in the past to prove to me that there is a connection between the Sacred Sakura and Makoto's consciousness. But unfortunately, you never did persuade me, did you?

120420517.text: No, but I understand why now. It was because the Sacred Sakura hadn't even been planted then.

120420518.text: Umm, but don't you think that tree looked a lot different than how it does now?

120420519.text: The Sacred Sakura is within my purview at the shrine, so obviously I get to prune it exactly how I like it.

120420520.text: Ugh... Now we see who's pulling the strings...

120420521.text: I'm joking. That tree has been through a lot since it first sprouted. We have the loving care of kitsune over the ages to thank for how it appears today.

120420522.text: And obviously I played my part, too.

120420523.text: It's fair to say that very little time passed between the moment you came out of that realm and the moment you re-entered it. But in that same time, centuries of battling took place on the inside, did it not?

120420524.text: Traveler, if I'm guessing correctly... You were repeating your wishes to yourself in your mind, weren't you?

120420527.text: At that time, I could sense Ei's whereabouts, but I also sensed anomalies in the flow of time within that space.

120420528.text: Suffice to say, time added a whole new dimension to our search. Simply establishing a location was not sufficient.

120420529.text: Fortunately, your will was strong enough that the turbulence carried you to the moment in time most likely to be the intersection of all that you were wishing for.

120420530.text: The flow of turbulence may well have been influenced by Makoto. But it took everyone's efforts combined to ultimately help Ei. So this time, it looks like thanks are due to you.

120420531.text: Does that mean... it wasn't by chance that we ended up at the final duel? We were always meant to be there to witness what was going to happen?

subQuests.subQuestName: Force your way into the realm
Speak to Ei and get up to speed with the situation
Witness the end of the long battle

120420401.text: This is the end. You have won.

120420402.text: I believed you were incapable of transcending the past. But it seems my belief was baseless and I underestimated your spirit.

120420403.text: But a will that cannot be eroded has no way to embrace the future.

120420404.text: You need not worry about the future, and you aren't alone.

120420405.text: I know your power more than anyone else. Had I relied upon my strength alone, I would have lost this duel for sure.

120420406.text: Yet my reason for fighting redefined my martial prowess and redrew my limits. I now carry the gaze of the myriad of expectant eyes that look to the light in the heavens.

120420407.text: And whenever I think of this, I feel something stirring within Musou Isshin.

120420408.text: The blade that I inherited from Makoto seems to be trying to guide me... to encourage me.

120420409.text: I noticed it also. Just now, in the heat of battle, it seemed to unleash a new and unfamiliar power.

120420410.text: This power is beyond the limits of my understanding.

120420411.text: This blade belonged to Mak{RUBY#[S]the previous Shogun}oto. Perhaps it can only respond to me with its full power when I truly understand and believe in her.

120420412.text: When I clasped Musou Isshin in my hands, I had the feeling that she was by my side once again.

120420413.text: It was at once a familiar feeling and a strange one... Makoto barely wielded a blade in her life, and yet her blade brings me closer to her.

120420415.text: Your present will is not the product of erosion. I shall no longer stop you from attempting to modify the rules.

120420416.text: From this day forth, this body will remain your assistant.

120420417.text: I won't design any more rules that can never be changed.

120420418.text: You used to represent my past, but from today onward, you are me.

120420419.text: Makoto never saw me as a fearless weapon. Likewise, I should not regard you as a mere tool.

120420420.text: ...Heh, you truly have changed. I suppose this is what humans call "growth."

120420421.text: I understand. I shall become your shadow, just as you were once Makoto's shadow.

120420422.text: The duties I perform will not change.

120420423.text: But as a warrior, I look forward to the chance to fight like this again in the future.

120420424.text: Do you say this because you have not yet reconciled yourself with your defeat?

120420425.text: It was simply a new experience for me. One that is worth reliving.

120420426.text: Have you finished fighting, then? Like, for real this time?

120420429.text: Hello Ei, and greetings, those who have come to bear witness.

120420430.text: I am Raiden Makoto, the previous Electro Archon, who failed in my duties and left you all to pick up the pieces.

120420432.text: I'm so happy. You've come so far. I always knew you would make it here in the end.

120420433.text: I left a faint fragment of my will in Musou Isshin, so that in the moment that you unleashed its full power, I too would be released.

120420434.text: A convoluted way to reach you, but... Well, you held such deeply entrenched views at the time that you wouldn't have listened to a word I said.

120420435.text: There was no time to wait for you to have a change of heart. Please forgive me... All I could do was find some way to wait until you came to me.

120420436.text: But you never mentioned this to me...

120420437.text: Everything happened so suddenly... I'm sorry.

120420438.text: I've always felt terrible for having to entrust Inazuma to you all of a sudden.

120420439.text: I should have been the one to impart these ideas to you a little at a time, to dissuade you from your pursuit of stillness.

120420440.text: Did you know what was about to happen in Khaenri'ah?

120420441.text: I had some sense of it. That place... was not somewhere that any archon could afford to ignore.

120420442.text: In my present form, I can no longer perceive time. I don't know how long we have been separated before this reunion, and I don't know what Inazuma has experienced in the meantime.

120420443.text: But I know that this must have been an extremely arduous journey for you... and I'm sure you must have wanted to shed tears many times along the way.

120420446.text: It was with this possibility in mind that I left a parting gift for you... something to soothe Inazuma's pain.

120420447.text: Here, take it. Before my last shred of consciousness fades away.

120420448.text: But it is you who must take the most important step...

subQuests.subQuestName: Witness the beginning of the dream
Talk to Ei and Yae Miko

120429901.text: The time our duels took to fight was long enough to witness the rise and fall of nations.

120429902.text: The energy they consumed, great enough to vaporize the oceans and turn day into night.

120429903.text: And the will they demanded, sufficient to penetrate minds and crush dreams.
